author: sky.cactus
content:
When is the appropriate time, and what is the appropriate venue, for discussing state growth targets?

There are several EIPs being reviewed and worked on that address state growth in various ways, and they all come with an implicit state growth target that doesn't seem to be discussed anywhere in public that I can find.  When I ask, "the exact target is just a constant we can set later" but I'm concerned that constant will be set without meaningful discussion in public (this is a common historic theme).
